message.reasoning_content: Record description update. Key risk: FP32 arithmetic vs tolerance 1e-7+5e-7|target| — FP32 single-op precision can fail componentwise tolerance for ill-conditioned inputs; no Smith's algorithm; overflow in c*c+d*d at FP16 max (65504² ≈ 4.3e9, fine in FP32); FP32 intermediate error ~1e-7 relative may exceed 5e-7 tolerance marginally.
